capture.notes: codex-rs/core/src/context_manager/history.rs:488 defines RESIZED_IMAGE_BYTES_ESTIMATE = 7373. Lines 522-535 replace raw base64 payload bytes with 7373 bytes while preserving JSON wrappers. 7373 bytes ceil-divided by 4 yields 1844 tokens. Without this heuristic, a large raw base64 payload (e.g. 100KB) would count as 25000 tokens and trigger compaction prematurely.
